messages:
elaine: Heads up — request from SecureHSM + Azure marketplace team: they want a single coordinated playbook for SSO/SCIM + KMS/HSM + marketplace listing + joint announcement. Target date they've proposed: 2026-04-28 for the co-announcement. Who can own the security integration checklist (attestation, key custody modes, FIPS + algorithm support) vs. partner enablement (SAML metadata flow, SCIM mappings, test accounts)?

mike: I can own the security checklist. Quick notes: we need explicit KMS key custody options documented (customer-managed in KeyVault vs partner-HSM wrapped keys), HSM attestation proof (certificate chain), and supported crypto suites. Also confirm HSM exports are disabled and that PKCS#11 + KMIP compatibility is listed.

anita: Proposed phased rollout to reduce blast radius: 1) SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning (GA-ready docs) — public docs + partner test accounts. 2) KMS integration (private beta) with SecureHSM — include HSM attestation artifacts, key policy samples, and QA plan. 3) Marketplace listing + joint marketing + co-announcement.

jordan: On marketplace side I need: partner logos, short feature bullets (1–2 lines each), sample billing SKU names, and whether this will be listed under "Redwood Dedicated" or a separate tile for "Redwood + SecureHSM". Legal will need the draft co-marketing language.

mike: For engineering docs, here's a minimal SCIM attribute mapping we should publish (customers will ask):

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "add",
      "path": "",
      "value": {
        "userName": "user@example.com",
        "name": {"givenName": "First", "familyName": "Last"},
        "emails": [{"value": "user@example.com", "primary": true}],
        "externalId": "okta-12345"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

mike: And SAML exchange notes: ACS URL = `https://api.redwood.ai/saml/consume`, EntityID = `https://redwood.ai/saml/metadata`. We'll provide metadata XML and a test IdP container for partners to validate.

elaine: Great. Anita — can you own the customer-facing docs for phase 1? Jordan — marketplace and co-marketing. Mike — security + HSM checks and PB. I'll coordinate partner comms and the announcement timeline.

anita: Yes, I'll draft the SAML/SCIM quickstart and a short QA checklist for provisioning flows. ETA for draft: 2026-04-08.

jordan: I'll draft the marketplace copy and ask for logos + one pager from SecureHSM by EOD Friday. Also booking marketing sync for 2026-04-10. :calendar:

mike: I'll start the HSM attestation thread and collect vendor certs. Need engineering owners for key policy examples — tagging @eng-security is fine. Quick question: do we plan to support BYOK flow in v1 of the integration?

elaine: We should support BYOK for enterprise accounts in private beta (phase 2). Public GA can be Redwood-managed keys + optional BYOK later if we can't complete attestation in time.

mike: Sounds good. I'll assemble a test matrix (attestation, key-create, key-wrap/unwrap, rotation) and post it here by 2026-04-06.

anita: For the announcement, suggested messaging: "Redwood now supports SecureHSM-backed key management via Azure Key Vault for low-latency, FIPS-compliant secrets management — with seamless SSO and SCIM provisioning." We'll iterate with comms/legal.

jordan: Noted. I'll loop in legal and partner ops. Also, do we want a joint webinar the week after the announcement? Partners usually like that.

elaine: Yes — tentatively schedule webinar for 2026-05-05. I'll create the invite once we have draft content.

ci-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Partner playbook review" on 2026-04-12 assigned to [elaine, anita, mike, jordan]. Checklist created: SAML metadata, SCIM mapping, HSM attestation, BYOK doc, marketplace assets, co-marketing draft.

mike: One more thing — add a compatibility matrix for supported KeyVault SKUs and region restrictions. Some regions have different HSM availability.

anita: Adding that to docs backlog.

elaine: Owners recap: Security & HSM = mike; Phase 1 docs = anita; Marketplace & comms = jordan; Partner coordination + announcement = elaine. Next sync 2026-04-06 for technical alignment (mike to present test matrix). Thanks all :thumbsup:
